coverage_override.reason: The hand summon procedure, its resulting summon lock, and the detached-material trigger with its HOPT are three audit units.

effects.printed_clause: If you control no monsters, or control a Dragon Xyz Monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC checks an open zone and either an empty controlled Monster Zone or a face-up controlled Dragon Xyz Monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a condition-checked, non-activated hand Special Summon procedure.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon WATER monsters for the rest of this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The procedure operation registers a player-targeted EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON through the End Phase whose filter rejects WATER monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers a procedure-result player restriction with a phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz Monster to activate its effect: target 1 non-Xyz Stellaer monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but banish it when it leaves the field. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GLOBALFLAG_DETACH_EVENT and EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL now catch the detach regardless of destination. The condition verifies prior overlay location, cost reason, and the Stellaer Xyz source; resolution revives the target and gives it a leave-field banish redirect.

official_references.matched_structure: Enables GLOBALFLAG_DETACH_EVENT and registers a trigger on EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL.
Special Summons a selected monster and applies a leave-field redirect.

effects.issue: Fixed: EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL replaces EVENT_TO_GRAVE, removing the unstated requirement that detachment send this card to the GY.
